mapper.select: SELECT a.application_id AS applicationId, a.application_name AS applicationName, a.owner_team AS ownerTeam, a.risk_level AS riskLevel, COALESCE(p.phase,'ANALYSIS') AS phase, COALESCE(p.status,'NOT_STARTED') AS status, COALESCE(p.progress_percent,0) AS progressPercent, p.owner_name AS ownerName, p.planned_end_date AS plannedEndDate, p.notes AS notes, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM modernization_application a LEFT JOIN modernization_progress p ON p.application_id=a.application_id ORDER BY a.application_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM modernization_application a LEFT JOIN modernization_progress p ON p.application_id=a.application_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM modernization_application WHERE application_id=#{id} AND deleted_yn='N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO modernization_progress (application_id,phase,status,progress_percent,owner_name,planned_end_date,notes,updated_by) VALUES(#{applicationId},#{phase},#{status},#{progressPercent},#{ownerName},#{plannedEndDate},#{notes},#{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE phase=VALUES(phase),status=VALUES(status),progress_percent=VALUES(progress_percent), owner_name=VALUES(owner_name),planned_end_date=VALUES(planned_end_date),notes=VALUES(notes),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by)
mapper.select: SELECT history_id AS historyId,old_phase AS oldPhase,new_phase AS newPhase, old_status AS oldStatus,new_status AS newStatus,old_percent AS oldPercent,new_percent AS newPercent, changed_by AS changedBy,changed_at AS changedAt FROM modernization_progress_history WHERE application_id=#{id} ORDER BY history_id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status='IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS inProgress, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status='BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS blocked, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(p.progress_percent,0)),1),0) AS averagePercent FROM modernization_application a LEFT JOIN modernization_progress p ON p.application_id=a.application_id WHERE a.deleted_yn='N'
